gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-piazzolla: Pramukh Rounded sits tight and friendly, its letters nearly touching. Underneath, Piazzolla brings classic serif authority, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, to steady the snug, rounded heading with a firmer hand.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like letters wide with room to spare. Noto Sans Meroitic follows in a plain sans whose small letters fill the line like capitals, so the page feels approachable under such a commanding heading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-multani: Commanding, wide-set Goldman leads with round forms that curve like open parentheses. Noto Sans Multani brings a lofty x-height and an e with a wide terminal gap, and that lift is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Wide, confident letters with round, parenthesis-like curves take the lead. Goldman holds the headline while Noto Sans Syriac Western, with terminals held far from the strokes, keeps extended reading modern and clean.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Widely spaced letters with curves like open parentheses, all swagger. Noto Sans Tai Tham settles in under Goldman with chalk-board lowercase crowding the cap line, so long text feels snug and contemporary.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tc: Bold Goldman sets wide, round letters over a big lowercase. Noto Sans TC counters with large open shapes in its tall a, e and s, and that outward-opening generosity is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kedebideri: Constant-width lines, held open and never curled shut, give a loud look. Kedebideri backs up Grandstander with rounded, inviting letters and a skyward x-height, so the two work together without fighting for attention.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-matangi: Uniform lines that stay open instead of curling shut, loud and plain. Matangi, with twine-like strokes and a hefty, rounded lowercase, would quickly outweigh Grandstander if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mozilla-headline: Loud lettering that looks drawn with constant pen pressure and short ascenders. Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so give Grandstander the larger size and let it lead.
